name: Haitoku Sensation
source:
Senpai x Kouhai!! Teacher x Teacher!! Girl x Girl (?)!!
The sensation of immoral couples on a certain campus.

Marika Shirai was a pervert teacher always on the edge of crossing over the cool line.
Hana Nishikigi was a math teacher who felt like something was missing in life.

School isn't everything! Studying isn't just about classroom busywork!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109393.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
前辈×红海！！老师×老师！！少女×少女（？）！！
某校园不道德情侣的轰动。

白井真理香是个变态老师，总是处于跨越酷线的边缘。
锦木花是一位数学老师，她觉得生活中缺少了一些东西。

学校不是一切！学习不仅仅是课堂上的忙碌！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109393.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
